decision: D40 (user 2026-11-14 17:22): the simulator's C# port of the physiology, margin and alarm logic must pass these cases
conventions: segment grade = atan(dz / horizontal length); time = horizontal length / v*(grade)
VO2 = V0 + (a(M) + k) v uphill/level; V0 + a(M) v clamp(f(i)/f(0)) downhill
a segment is impassable when |grade| > the variant's nogo_deg (or v* = 0)
margin = min(O2 term, daylight, dose, EVA duration); O2 term = (O2_left - O2_home - tasks_left - reserve) / effort rate; binding = the smallest term (ties: order O2, daylight, dose, EVA duration)
turn-back = latest departure from the station with m >= 0 at every vertex of the way home, O2 rising at the task rate while waiting
null where a number is not finite (unbounded latest departure, impassable segment)

derived.o2_reserve_label: 30 min at the effort cap (EMU precedent)

formulas.a_anchor: a_anchor = (anchor.vo2 - V0) / anchor.speed      # mL/kg/min per m/s
formulas.ist2_span_kg: span_kg = (g_frac[1] - g_frac[0]) * g_earth_ms2 * (system_kg + subject_kg) / crew.g_mars   # IST-2 weight span (ist2.weight_span) as carried mass at Mars g
formulas.uphill_k: k = (m_b + M) * g * sin(theta) / (eta * m_b) * 60 / 20.1   # theta > 0
formulas.vo2_uphill: VO2 = V0 + a(M) * v + k * v
formulas.vo2_downhill: VO2 = V0 + a(M) * v * clamp(f(i) / f(0), 0.4, 3.0)    # i = tan(theta) < 0
formulas.governor: v* = min(v_safe(theta), (effort_cap * VO2max - V0) / (a(M) + k))   # downhill: divide by a(M)*f(i)/f(0)

o2_margin.label: minutes at maximum effort
o2_margin.reserve_label: 30 min at the effort cap (EMU precedent)

formulas.speed: v_haul = min(v_safe(theta), eps * P / F); downhill: min(v_haul, 0.5 * v_safe)
formulas.infeasible: v_haul < 0.1 m/s or F > boot_mu * (m_b + suit + tools) * g * cos(theta)

notes: The planner plans with O2 used before each leg bounded at the effort-cap rate (1.35 L/min x elapsed time; user 2026-11-14 17:28); timeline rows show the modelled O2.
Timeline values are rounded to 0.01 as in the timeline contract.
o2_checkpoint rows: T_home / O2_home of the last track vertex at or before t; O2 used linearly interpolated between vertices.
